    Visiting Charnwood Eco Hub

    Accessibility

    Charnwood Eco Hub has moved to 7-8 Baxter Gate, Loughborough LE11 1TG.

    We are on the ground floor, and now have accessible toilet facilities.

    We also have a parking space which we can reserve for customers with mobility issues on request.

    There are bus stops right outside and the nearest public car park is at Beacon Bingo hall.

    Where to find us

    Opening Hours:
    Monday: 2-6pm
    Wednesday: 4-8pm
    Thursday: 10am-2pm
    Saturday: 10am-2pm

    Address: 7–8 Baxter Gate, Loughborough LE11 1TG
